## ForceConnect 2.0 — rebuilt from the ground up

ForceConnect 2.0 is a complete rewrite of the original C#/WinForms app, now built with **Rust and Tauri**. It does the same job — switching your DNS in one click — but faster, lighter, and with encrypted DNS built in.

### ✨ Highlights

- **Encrypted DNS, natively** — DNS-over-HTTPS, DNS-over-TLS, DNS-over-QUIC and DoH3 run through a resolver inside the app. No bundled third-party binaries, no proxies to set up.
- **22 servers from 12 providers** — Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, AdGuard, Control D, OpenDNS, Mullvad, Shecan, Electro, RadarGame, 403.Online and Begzar, including malware-blocking and family-safe variants. You can also add your own.
- **Live latency** — every server is pinged so the fastest one for your network is obvious.
- **One-click connect** — pick a server, press the button. ForceConnect probes the server, applies it to your active adapter, and flushes the DNS cache, showing each step as it goes.
- **Network interfaces view** — see every adapter, which one is active, and where its DNS comes from.
- **Crash-safe** — a restore journal puts your original DNS back, even after a crash, forced shutdown or power loss.
- **One admin prompt, at launch** — no background service, no scheduled task, nothing left running after you close it.
- **New interface** — a redesigned bento layout with light and dark themes, start with Windows, and close to tray.
- **Tiny** — a ~3 MB installer.

### ⚠️ Good to know

- **Windows SmartScreen** may warn that the installer is from an unrecognized publisher, because it isn't code-signed yet. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Auto-update isn't active in this release.** Future versions will need to be installed manually until it's turned on.
- Coming from **1.x**? 2.0 is a full rewrite. The 1.x source and releases remain available on the [`legacy-csharp`](https://github.com/Mxqius/ForceConnect/tree/legacy-csharp) branch.

### 🐞 Feedback

Found a bug or want a DNS provider added? [Open an issue](https://github.com/Mxqius/ForceConnect/issues). Adding a provider needs no Rust — just edit [`servers.json`](https://github.com/Mxqius/ForceConnect/blob/main/src-tauri/crates/dns/servers.json).
